crossRefs.note: Saul sent messengers to David’s house, to watch him, and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him…
When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”
The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent…
The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
“After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you…
Then Yahweh’s Spirit will come mightily on you, and you will prophesy with them, and will be turned into another man.
When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and…
Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy…
But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on…
“It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy.…

The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul sent messengers to seize David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.
translations.bsb: he sent messengers to seize him. But when they saw the group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel leading them, the Spirit of God came upon them, and Saul’s messengers also began to prophesy.
translations.kjv: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
translations.asv: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
